Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square avatar for an AI player in a fantasy card-game chat.
Primary request: a flat, somewhat cartoonish portrait of a robot version of a fantasy archetype.
Style/medium: clean flat 2D cartoon illustration, thick charcoal outlines, large rounded geometric shapes, restrained cel shading, no texture, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D.
Composition/framing: one centered head-and-shoulders character facing the viewer, oversized expressive mechanical face, silhouette contained with generous margins so a circular crop does not cut off the headgear. No full body, no scene, no border.
Materials: clearly robotic metal facial plates, simple glowing eyes and visible mechanical joints; no organic skin.
Constraints: readable at 32 to 48 pixels, calm friendly personality, simple solid muted background, no text, lettering, logos or watermark. Cohesive collectible avatar-pack aesthetic.
Subject: A broad, green-metal robot orc with pointed mechanical ears, chunky riveted jaw and two short ivory-metal tusks, ochre shoulder straps, friendly determined expression. Muted warm sage background.

Clearly an animated botanical robot rather than a human in a costume. Muted pale sage background. Keep the silhouette bold and compact.
